notes.title: Difficulty Levels Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Greetings Hunters![/h2]

[previewyoutube=FS_6Teo9rvE;full][/previewyoutube]
In this update we are happy to add difficulty levels to the game! There are now three to choose from: casual, hunter and realistic. Animals in casual mode have weaker senses and it is perfect when you just want to go on a relaxing hunt. It also helps you locate animals by highlighting an animal when you activate their call.

When you want to really push your hunting skills, realistic mode provides a real challenge! Animals have strong senses so getting close leaves very little room for mistakes. Track and carcass highlights are also turned off by default so good shot placement is key since tracking will be more difficult. They can be turned back on from the settings. This mode provides higher rewards. Hunter is the default difficulty that the game has offered so far.

You can change the difficulty when starting the game but it can’t be changed during gameplay. Trophy statues in the trophy room will also display the difficulty level.

We also adjusted vegetation settings so please test and adjust them. More about this change is in the patch notes below.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41156574/19bc75c6630695fd12d56022919c8985d4561329.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Added three difficulty settings: casual, hunter and realistic
[*] Casual has lower animal senses, activating an animal call will highlight the animal, and rewards are smaller
[*] Hunter is the default difficulty that the game has been so far. Animal hearing and sight are slightly increased in closer distance.
[*] Realistic mode is a real challenge for master hunters! It has strong animal senses, track and carcase highlights are turned off by default but it provides higher rewards.
[*] You can change the difficulty at the main menu but it can’t be changed during gameplay
[/list]

notes.title: Shadow And Lighting Update
notes.notes:
Hello Hunters!

We have a new update for you with improvements to the lighting, added soft shadows, improved fog and other environment changes! We heard your feedback about the game being too dark and grey so this update should significantly improve that. Just make sure that the right OpenXR runtime is set active before launching the game. We have pinned instructions on how to do this in the forums!

The update also includes a lot of changes, improvements, long awaited bug fixes and much, much more! notes.title: Red Fox &.223 Rifle Update | Fixes And Changes #1
notes.notes:
[h1]Greetings Hunters![/h1]

We received feedback how our new optics and magnifications were not correct and they were too small. Thank you for that! After testing and diving deeper into this, we realized that the calculations we used were not correct and magnifications were all over the place. To fix this, we completely reworked them by measuring their magnifications by hand based on real life metrics instead of relying on Unity’s camera FOV and different calculations. All optics now and in the future will use this system and are as true to life as possible.

notes.title: Virtual Hunter's Anniversary And Development Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Greetings Hunters![/h1]

Exactly one year ago today, we released Virtual Hunter for early access. It was exciting to finally put out our game that we had been working on for so long. We also knew that this was just the beginning and our real work was just starting. Through the year we have added several new species, tons of features, fixed issues reported by players and improved the graphics and performance. Our biggest update has been animal taxidermy and trophy mounts, which was well received and gave players freedom to show off their most treasured trophies in the lodge. It’s been an amazing journey so far and we want to take this time to thank everyone who has played. We have read every comment, appreciated all feedback and enjoyed the discussions in our Discord community. Our goal is to create the best VR hunting experience and chose early access so we can do so with the players. The game would not be what it is today without all of you. Cheers to all of you virtual hunters!

We'd like to also give you an update on what is going on with Virtual Hunter’s development since our last update. We started a big process of moving the game from SteamVR to OpenXR and updating our engine and tools to newer versions. This way we future proof the game for other platforms, improve useability and performance for headsets on Steam that doesn’t use SteamVR and simplify the process on our end to work on different versions of the game. This is a massive task and requires us to completely rewrite big parts of the game regarding interactions and rendering. Good news is that we are making good progress but it will take us sometime to get it fully done and ready for you guys. This is necessary for us to do because it gives us more flexibility, more tools and features to work on the upcoming content faster! 

Even though we are mainly working on this big change, we have a content update planned in between. You can expect teasers of it when we are getting closer to it as always! I’m sure you'll like it :)

notes.title: Deer Species Animation Rework Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Greetings Hunters![/h1]

Ready your gear since it’s time for another update! This time we have a complete rework for our deer species with new animations, new behaviors and much more! This rework focused on bringing more life to the deer species and to give players more cues how aware they are of their surroundings. You can spot them stomping the ground if they know something is wrong, sniff the air when you are badly positioned and a wounded deer slowly walks with its head down, making it easier to spot from the group. They also have a chance to quickly drop down when shot at with a bow, so take this into account in your shot placement and aim lower, so you won’t shoot over the deer! 

The update also includes several improvements, especially to animal footsteps and call spatialization. This makes locating animal sounds a lot easier and accurate in game.

[h1]Hello Hunters![/h1]
With this major update, we are introducing animal taxidermy and trophy mounts to the game! The trophy mounting system gives players complete freedom with the trophy placement. These colorful medium sized deer with big antlers and thick necks can be found mostly around leaf and mixed forest areas. In this update we introduce our first new animal - Wild Boar! These loud and heavily built animals are found in big groups all around the reserve. Check the area for their unique feeding tracks and lure them in with the brand new caller. But you better carry the new .44 revolver with you since on a rare occasion the boars can turn aggressive if you get too close.

notes.title: Launch Patch - Fixes And Changes #3
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello hunters![/h1]
We have another update for you and just in time for the holidays! This patch includes some quality of life changes, reworked animal paralyzation, improvements to the inventory (you can now lock it in place!) and much more! 

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added left handed support for .303 rifle. The weapon is now mirrored when grabbed with the left hand, just like the bow. Scope rail is slightly over the chamber but doesn’t affect loading the weapon.
[*] Increased distance when hand will ungrab from .303s bolt
[*] Added book stands on shelves
[*] Reworked spine hits and animal paralyzation. Animals will now fall over with spine hits, get paralyzed and will stare at the player when getting close. They will slowly bleed out so additional shots are required.*
[*] Added “Game paused” text and game logo to the in-game menu.
[*] Droppings are now an additional track and won’t replace footprint
[*] Reduced snap turn delay
[*] Reduced .303s stabilization when holding breath without a scope
[*] Changed droppings' times slightly. They go faster from fresh to aged. This means that fresh droppings now indicate that animals are more likely still close.
[*] Increased track duration
[*] Moved shooting range targets closer and lower when inspecting them
[*] Added some hints to loading screens
[*] Added lock feature to the inventory. By pressing the lock button, it will lock the inventory in place and it won’t turn with your head
[*] Inventory will now turn smoothly when it’s rotation is updated when looking down
[/list]
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where animals could return to the same spot after fleeing
[*] Fixed an issue where backup button could create an empty save instead of copying the actual save
[*] Fixed the harvest screens slider
[*] Fixed an issue where you could harvest tutorial animal too early, skipping harvest screen tutorial completely
[*] Fixed an issue where run toggle didn’t change to other joystick when movement hand was changed from the menu
[*] Fixed an issue where inventory would turn random degrees instead of the set amount
[*] Fixed a crash when quitting game from the in-game menu or main menu
[*] Fixed a crash when changing stance with joystick while hanging from a ladder
[/list]
*Male red deer can sometimes have issues with the new spine hit. We are reworking the animations and the model a bit and this issue will be fixed when they are released.

Happy hunting and Happy Holidays!
